name: web-minimal-header-styles-catalog-with-chair-hero
title: Minimal Header Styles Catalogue
whatItIs: A tall feature sheet of 19 website header variations for a minimal theme: horizontal bars with centered, split and left logos, and side-menu layouts over a white and black chair hero, plus a free-font QR badge.
whatItMeans: Listing every variation at small scale shows range at a glance, and the grayscale product photography keeps focus on the layout differences.
techniques: Repeat one component in many variations stacked vertically
Grayscale palette so structure is the only variable
A single hero product (chair) shown in light and dark versions
Tiny uppercase nav labels with an underline for the active item

vocabulary.definition: An alternate arrangement of logo, navigation and utilities.
A vertical menu docked to one side.
A large faint number used as background decoration.
